scene.line: I have a story to tell of the ghost of Fairy Tale Theater.
Yes, this one stays at the theater because she loves plays.
This ghost watches all the plays here.
She even used to speak back lines to actors.
Yes, and this one actually can sing.
The ghost sang to actors in plays, scaring everyone.
I bet you this ghost would sing to us if we called to her.
I'm not sure we should try it guys.
I think it's a great idea.
Um, how would we even call to her?
Wait it sounds familiar... Shimmer you scared us!
It was just your pet hummingbird?
I guess there really wasn't a ghost after all.
I guess not, let's go guys.
